_comment: Daily rotation, used when announce/queue has nothing due. One app a day: the app posted longest ago (or never) goes next,
in the order listed here; its posts are used in turn and start over once all are used.
Add an app: add an entry with its url and 2-3 posts (under 300 characters, include the link).
Stop an app: add its repo name to 'skip'. Live Pages sites not listed here get a generic post from the repo description.
